3099-3995-6723.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
3099-3995-6723.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-3995-6723.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

2770-3752-8193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Phage.
2770-3752-8193.description:
Donate control of Avacyn to an opponent using Donate.
Kill Phage by any method.
At the beginning of the next end step, Avacyn triggers, returning Phage from your graveyard to the battlefield under the opponent's control.
When Phage enters, its first ability triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

1339-2438-3394.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2438-3394.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

618-2292-6132.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Vizier of Many Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

598-2452-2511.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast a Zombie from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Zombie
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7204.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Merrow Skyswimmer, adding {C}{C}.
When Merrow Skyswimmer dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Merrow Skyswimmer from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Merrow Skyswimmer enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2292-4311-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2292-4311-4871-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating three creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus and giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

321-399-2475-3375-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

362-4944--23.description:
Activate the zero-cost artifact's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Crackdown Construct.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the equip ability, attaching the artifact to Crackdown Construct.
Repeat.

1770-2226-3570.manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1770-2226-3570.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{G}{W}{W}.
1770-2226-3570.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{G}{W}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{G}{W}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Emancipation Angel by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Emancipation Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{G}{W}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may use that mana to activate Zacama's other abilities.

2281-3604-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' first ability by tapping it, adding {G/W}.
Cast Saffi Eriksdotter by paying {G}{W}.
When Saffi Eriksdotter enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Saffi Eriksdotter, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Saffi Eriksdotter.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping the Saffi Eriksdotter token, adding one mana of any color.
Activate the Saffi Eriksdotter token by sacrificing it, targeting the nontoken Saffi Eriksdotter.
Activate Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing it, targeting Cadric.
When the nontoken Saffi Eriksdotter dies, the token Saffi Eriksdotter triggers, returning the nontoken Saffi Eriksdotter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

948-2060-2433-2486-3062.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield.
You have at least one +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
948-2060-2433-2486-3062.description:
Activate Ooze Flux by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Ooze creature token, which will enter the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters due to Pir and Master Chef.
Rosie Cotton of South Lane triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Pir.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2060-3490-3517-4772-4868.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2060-3490-3517-4772-4868.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Tainted Observer, causing you to pay {2} to put four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers four times.
Resolve the first three Animation Module triggers, choosing not to pay.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the final Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

430-1061-4438.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
430-1061-4438.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Beledros Witherbloom triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
